summary: Correct, minimal fix: removes lossy to_native_string from the shared _encode_params (which mangled/failed on non-ASCII bytes bodies) and reinstates it only in the prepare_url path where native query strings are actually required. Matches the real upstream resolution; preserves binary body payloads while keeping URL param behavior intact.

issues.description: to_native_string conversion is now split between prepare_url and _encode_params; an inline comment explaining why URL params need native-string coercion but body data must pass through raw would aid future maintainers.
